claim: Shopware 6 is an open headless commerce platform built on Symfony 7 and Vue.js 3
API-first, extensible through plugins (Symfony bundles) and apps, headless if needed
More than 3,100 extensions in the community store
Recommended on-premise install is the flex template; web installer and Docker development setup exist
Commercial plans and the Shopware cloud are sold by the vendor; hosting partners offer pre-installed shops
Contributors sign a CLA giving Shopware AG the right to use their code
